fF.role: online baseline on a fresh point

fL.role: online candidate on a fresh point

qF.role: online baseline on Q0: the pipeline's full scan

qFx2.role: online planted positive control on Q0 (full scan plus one discarded full scan per probe); also measures the marginal cost of one canonicalization per probe

qG.role: secondary on Q0: variant B in the online path

qV.role: online exactness on Q0 and each fresh point, not timed

rT.role: A's tuned rho (Fold/64/DP6, crypto 770f6a69), the strongest rho measured at n=83 (reconcile rT770); gap reference on the same points

sBx2.role: stage planted positive control: variant B plus one discarded variant-B call per word

baselines.online: B's one-target IC pipeline (experiments/koblitz-single-target-n83-tier1-20261014, run 38523707244; reproduced by koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014 as iB770c): crypto 770f6a69 koblitz_orbit_dlp_fast_online + ic_log_cache.patch, cached verified factor-log table, retained K600 base d4a4da26...a9f7, curve EC1N83Ce1h35c7ced6b497. Its target scan canonicalizes every partner root with NormalBasis128::canonical, the FULL 83-rotation scan (source audit: scan_state128 calls basis.canonical, not canonical_selected; KIC_SPARSE_CANONICAL affects only the index build). KIC_TARGET_CANON=full is that code path, byte-for-byte in behaviour.
baselines.source_audit_finding: Variant B is the canonicalizer of the E-1 packed-index stage only. In the one-target online pipeline the canonicalization is the full scan, inside target_PDP (scan_state128: per probe, to_normal.apply(partner) then canonical, then the root-table lookup). So the online baseline arm is the full scan; variant B online (qG) is a secondary arm.
baselines.stage: Variant B, packed_bucket22_fastcanon of experiments/koblitz-n83-index-design-20260929/packed_index_e1_canonical_20261009 (Tier 1 replay packed_index_e1_canonical_tier1_20261014: canonicalization phase 1.086 [1.076, 1.094] over the full scan). Curve EC1N83Ckb1h876c2921cb64, workload 981ac530e67e, 2,000,000 pair states, 22-bit bucket directory, 18-byte records, crypto 904f0f84.

controls_pass_rule.aa: 95% interval inside [0.97, 1.03] (stage: both quantities; online: Q0)
controls_pass_rule.planted: 95% interval lower bound > 1 (stage canonicalization phase; online Q0)

decision_rule.invalid: any gate, exactness check or control fails, or any primary unit is missing: no verdict at that level; every row is preserved
decision_rule.levels: stage verdict from stage_primary; online verdict from online_q0_primary and online_fresh_primary, each classified; a pipeline (online) improvement requires both online primaries 'improvement' and the online controls passing; the stage verdict never changes the online verdict
decision_rule.ratchet: an online improvement makes the lift_scan pipeline the new one-target baseline, recorded with the online ratio and the S_rho delta; a stage-only improvement is recorded as a stage improvement
decision_rule.scope: Tier 1 instance scope, one runner; Q0 intervals cover timing and repeat variation, not targets; the fresh panel has the target variation. Not a claim to beat rho: the tuned-rho gap is reported as distance remaining.

design.host: one fresh GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runner (Tier 1 instance scope); every run one process pinned to one execution CPU (minimum of the affinity mask), clean environment, RAYON/KIC threads 1
design.order: X (exactness: sV, then qV on Q0 and w00..w15), S1..S16, then Q1, F1(w00,w01), Q2, F2(w02,w03), ..., Q8, F8(w14,w15); within-segment orders from make_schedule.py's seeded shuffles
design.runtime_estimate: build+tests 15-25 min; X 17 verify IC processes x 50-90 s + 1 stage verify ~30 s = 15-26 min; S 64 stage processes x 8-15 s = 9-16 min; Q 40 IC x 40-60 s + 8 rho x 2-5 s = 27-41 min; F 32 IC x 40-55 s + 16 rho = 22-30 min; total about 1.5-2.3 h (reconcile run 38617911080: cached IC process wall median 41-45 s, tuned rho 2-3 s)

gates: isolated_bench Tier 1 counters per run: exit 0, no timeout, verified=1, binary digest unchanged, no memory events (oom/oom_kill); contention flags recorded and reported

stage arm: frozen pair certificate, frozen canonical-rotation counts of its mode, native control PASS, RSS <= 1024 MiB, phase accounting (query prep + S3 batch + partner check <= target stage; canonical + lookup <= partner check)
ic arm: verified cached table on the frozen base, requested canonicalizer reported, full-scan index build, five phases sum to the online interval, setup ends before the online interval
exactness: sV 12,000,064 words with zero variant-B and zero lift_scan disagreements; every qV run (Q0 + 16 fresh) with words = probes and zero disagreements

pair identity: on each point every IC arm (incl. qV) has the same probe count, relation (point indices) and recovered scalar; IC and tuned rho recover the same scalar on every point; every scalar replays as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle; Q0's scalar equals the validation sidecar
multiplicity: two levels x one primary each (online has two panels, both required); no correction is applied to the controls; secondaries are reported, never decide

online.factor_log_table_policy: B's archived table; re-verified before any timing by ../koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/verify_log_table.py in the pinned pure-Python oracle; every IC arm additionally verifies all [L_j]G = R_j in process before target work
online.online_interval: producer's own clock: target_query_begin .. recovery_check_end, five exclusive phases (query, PDP, relation check, descent, recovery check); index build, log-table load and verification, process launch outside

question: Does the exact two-limb binary-lifting canonicalizer lift_scan (variant-A analogue) lower cost against the current n=83 index-calculus baseline, (1) at stage level against variant B (the zero-gap scan) in the frozen E-1 canonical root stage, and (2) over the full one-target IC online interval of B's pipeline on Q0 and B's 16 fresh points?

stage.expected_counts_note: [index_build, target stage]. Variant B and full-scan counts are the frozen E-1 rows'; the lift_scan counts (nonzero-shift candidate rotations) are deterministic and were read from the local exactness run before freezing; they are correctness expectations, not timing.
stage.pair_certificate_definition: sha256 of benchmark_stage.canonical over benchmark_stage.PAIR_FIELDS (20 fields incl. lookup_sample keys and stored shifts, hit counts, outcome, native control); the frozen E-1 rows' certificate
stage.verify_words_definition: every word the frozen stage canonicalizes: 4,000,000 index roots + 8,000,000 target partner roots + 64 lookup-sample roots

statistics.S: S_probe = root-index probes / sqrt(r) (invariant here by construction: probes are a pair field). S_rho = (IC online ms / tuned-rho ms per walk step) / sqrt(r), the online cost priced in this job's tuned-rho steps (ms per step = median over all rT runs of online_ms / walk_steps); reported for the old (full) and new (lift) baseline on Q0 (median) and fresh (mean), with the delta
statistics.bootstrap: random.Random(seed); 10,000 resamples with replacement of the units; statistic recomputed per resample; sorted; 95% interval = indices 250 and 9749
statistics.canonicalization_share: derived, Q0: per block (qFx2 - qF)/qF, the marginal time of one full-scan canonicalization per probe as a fraction of the baseline online interval; median, bootstrap seed 20261021; also (qF - qL)/qF (the realized saving) and the PDP share target_pdp_ms/online_ms of qF
statistics.online_fresh_primary: section 23: mean over the 16 points of fF online_ms / mean of fL online_ms; bootstrap over points, seed 2026101400
statistics.online_fresh_secondary: median of the 16 per-point ratios fF/fL, bootstrap seed 2026101401
statistics.online_q0_primary: online_ms, per block qF/qL; median of the 8 block ratios; bootstrap seed 20261016
statistics.online_q0_secondary: qG/qL (variant B vs lift_scan online) and qF/qG, per block, median, seeds 20261017/20261018
statistics.rho_gap: Q0: per block rT/qF and rT/qL (rho seed varies by block), median and ratio of means over blocks, seeds 20261022/20261023; fresh: section 23 mean rT / mean fF and mean rT / mean fL, bootstrap over points, seeds 2026101402/2026101403
statistics.stage_aa: sB/sBaa on both quantities, same estimator, seeds 20261013/20261014
statistics.stage_planted: sBx2/sB on the canonicalization phase, same estimator, seed 20261015
statistics.stage_primary: canonicalization phase timing_ns.target_cycle_canonical, per block ratio sB/sA; median of the 16 block ratios; bootstrap seed 20261011
statistics.stage_secondary: target stage timing_ns.target_pdp_and_native_check, per block sB/sA, same estimator, seed 20261012

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline' (branch claude/iterative-success-criterion, PR #919): a verified, measured improvement over the current IC baseline under a protocol frozen before timing; a stage win is a stage improvement and becomes a pipeline improvement only when it moves the online/end-to-end cost; each landed improvement becomes the new baseline with its delta.
